description: Soil properties at a point from SoilGrids 2.0 (ISRIC - World Soil Information, CC BY 4.0), 250 m mean predictions: clay, sand and silt (%), bulk density, coarse fragments, organic carbon (content, density and 0-30 cm stock), total nitrogen, cation exchange capacity and pH, at six depths from 0-5 cm to 100-200 cm. Built-up areas, water and permanent ice have no prediction, so the nearest mapped pixel within a few kilometres is used and reported in pixel. Model estimates, not measurements: ISRIC advises against using SoilGrids at the local or farm level, and they are not for engineering design. Units are in soil.units, and the source block holds the credit to pass on with the values.
